Here's your AspireAI squad:

| Member | Role | Domain |
|--------|------|--------|
| **Bob** | Lead / Architect | Solution architecture, service boundaries, tech decisions, code review, roadmap/priorities |
| **Jeff** | .NET Dev | C# (.NET 9), Blazor, Minimal API, Aspire AppHost, ServiceDefaults — owns the web frontend and orchestration wiring |
| **Jarvis** | Python / Data Dev | Python FastAPI, Neo4j, document ingestion, Pydantic models, Cypher queries — owns the processing service and graph DB |
| **Buster** | QA / Tester | Test strategy, pytest, xUnit, integration testing, quality analysis — guards the CI gate |
| **Scribe** | Session Logger | Silent background logger — auto-runs after substantial work sessions |
| **Ralph** | Work Monitor | Background monitor — tracks work in progress |

**You (@copilot)** act as the **Coding Agent**, handling well-defined implementation tasks: bug fixes, test coverage, small-to-medium features, dependency updates, and scaffolding.

Want me to spin up any of them on a task?
